Registration: SecureAgent wraps tools=/FunctionToolset functions into SecureToolset, registers decorators via _tool_decorator (register_ack for RunContext tools, own for plain), get_tools register_acks any unowned names, and run/run_sync/run_stream/override re-wrap per-call toolsets so overrides cannot bypass.

contracts.protection_obligation: Every agent tool execution routed through the adapter — tools= functions, @agent.tool/@agent.tool_plain decorated functions, FunctionToolset contents, other wrapped toolsets, and per-call toolsets passed to run/run_sync/run_stream/override — must first be authorized by the MACAW PEP via invoke_tool on the registered resource tool:<app>/<tool_name> before the tool runs. Owned tools are dispatched by MACAW's post-authorization handler and their result returned from the invoke; tools MACAW cannot hold (RunContext-taking tools, MCP and other non-FunctionToolset toolsets) are authorized via invoke and only then executed by the wrapped toolset. No tool runs until the PEP allows it. (Merges both reviewers' tool-execution wording from phase one and phase two.)

contracts.declared_mechanism: SecureModel builds policy params via _params and gates both paths through MacawBinding.invoke -> issuer.invoke_tool(tool_name='tool:<app>/generate', parameters=params, target_agent=self.server_id). Non-streaming: MACAW dispatches _handle_generate on its handler pool once the PEP allows the call, running wrapped.request and returning the serialized ModelResponse. Streaming: invoke with _authorize_only=True authorizes, then wrapped.request_stream yields events directly from the wrapped model. SecureAgent wraps plain, inferred, and router-candidate models via _secure_model and re-wraps per-call models in run/run_sync/run_stream/override so overrides cannot route around the adapter.
